title: BVEST 26 Messi Lines
subtitle: MESSI LINES 2026 was a robot football competition organised by BVP OPTICA in collaboration with TECHINNOVATE as part of BVEST XIII
description: BVEST 26 Messi Lines - The event combined the excitement of football with the innovation of robotics, challenging participants to apply their technical skills, strategic thinking, teamwork and problem-solving abilities through interactive gameplay.
location: Bharati Vidyapeeth's College of Engineering, New Delhi
highlights: explore the practical applications of engineering and robotics in a competitive and engaging environment, promoting innovation in line with UN Sustainable Development Goal 9: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure.
